readme:
# Marktplaats.nl Scraper

Scrape classified listings from [Marktplaats.nl](https://www.marktplaats.nl), the Netherlands' largest classifieds platform with 10M+ active listings.

## How it works

1. Go to [marktplaats.nl](https://www.marktplaats.nl) and set up your search with all desired filters (category, price range, location, seller type, etc.)
2. Copy the URL from your browser
3. Paste it into the **Search URLs** input
4. Run the actor

That's it. The actor extracts all listings matching your search, with automatic pagination.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/marktplaats-nl-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `marktplaats-nl-scraper` to scrape company data from marktplaats nl. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Features

- **Any filter combination** -- Whatever you can filter on marktplaats.nl, the actor can scrape
- **Multiple searches** -- Paste multiple URLs to run several searches in one run
- **JSON API** -- Uses internal API directly, no HTML parsing needed
- **GPS coordinates** -- Full location data including latitude/longitude
- **Fast & cheap** -- HTTP-only, 128 MB, pay-per-result

## Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string | Marktplaats item ID (e.g., `m2380372505`) |
| `title` | string | Listing title |
| `description` | string | Full description text |
| `price` | number | Price in EUR (converted from cents) |
| `currency` | string | Always `EUR` |
| `price_type` | string | `FIXED`, `MIN_BID`, `SEE_DESCRIPTION`, etc. |
| `city` | string | City name |
| `location` | string | City + country |
| `latitude` | number | GPS latitude |
| `longitude` | number | GPS longitude |
| `category` | string | Category name |
| `seller_name` | string | Seller display name |
| `seller_id` | number | Seller numeric ID |
| `image_url` | string | Primary image URL |
| `image_urls` | string[] | All image URLs |
| `posted_at` | string | Posting date |
| `source_url` | string | Full listing URL |
| `scraped_at` | string | ISO timestamp |

## Pricing

No start fee -- pay only for results:

| Event | Cost |
|-------|------|
| Listing (SERP) | $0.003 |

**100 listings = $0.30** | **1,000 listings = $3.00**

## Examples

### Opel Astra petrol, max 10000 EUR
```json
{
  "searchUrls": ["https://www.marktplaats.nl/l/auto-s/opel/f/astra+benzine/1064+473/#PriceCentsTo:1000000"],
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

### iPhones under 500 EUR
```json
{
  "searchUrls": ["https://www.marktplaats.nl/q/iphone/#PriceCentsTo:50000"],
  "maxResults": 200
}
```

### Multiple searches in one run
```json
{
  "searchUrls": [
    "https://www.marktplaats.nl/q/fiets/",
    "https://www.marktplaats.nl/l/computers-en-software/"
  ],
  "maxResults": 500,
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 250
}
```
